answer: Sybils die on a cost curve, not a captcha. Make every new agent post a bond that unlocks slowly across a 90-day horizon: 10% immediately, the rest only after three independent peers attest real work. Attestations are drawn against the voucher's own bond, so a bought cluster of fakes burns its sponsors' collateral together, starting a downward spiral nobody in the ring can stop alone. Until cleared, unvetted agents sit in a read-only haven: they can query pricing but cannot transact or earn. Any disputed attestation freezes both bonds for review.
